note: Suggested questions for Ask PitchSide (R5) about the synthetic hero match. at_t is the replay time (match seconds) at which each is asked; the Analyst's tools never look past it. q7 needs data the event log does not hold (distance run), so its answer must be a refusal.

questions.text: How many shots did D. Varga take after 60'?
How much npxG had Northbridge created by half-time?
Who scored, and in which minute?
Did Harlow's pass accuracy change after their yellow card?
How many times have Harlow lost the ball in their own third since 75'?
Who has taken the most shots in the match?
How far has C. Nkemelu run in the first half?
